mechanism_narrative: A persistent decline in the 3-month Treasury yield indicates a flattening yield curve, which lowers discount rates and increases present value of future equity cash flows, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in flattening periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the 3-month Treasury yield signals a steepening yield curve, which raises discount rates and compresses future equity present value, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in steepening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) above 200,000 jobs indicates a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in strengthening periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) below 100,000 jobs signals a weakening labor market, which reduces consumer and business optimism, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in weakening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in retail sales (HOUST) above 1,000 units signals stronger consumer demand, which accelerates corporate earnings growth and supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in rising sales periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly rise in industrial production (INDPRO) above 100 points indicates stronger supply-side capacity, which reduces production costs and supports higher corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in expanding production periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the 3-month Treasury yield combined with rising consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) indicates a flattening yield curve and rising real interest rates, which compress future equity present value and drive negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: flattening yield curve with rising inflation
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in flattening-inflation periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate falling below 5% indicates a tight labor market, which raises wage growth and consumer spending, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in tight labor periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
